```tsx
    importance: 2,
    masteryPercentage: 65
  },
  {
    id: 3,
    title: 'What is the difference between innate and adaptive immunity?',
    status: 'Not started',
    answer: 'Innate immunity is the first line of general defense. Adaptive immunity is specific and creates memory cells (B and T cells).',
    importance: 1,
    masteryPercentage: 0
  },
  {
    id: 4,
    title: 'How does photosynthesis work?',
    status: 'Practicing',
    answer: 'Plants convert light energy into chemical energy, using CO2 and water to produce glucose and oxygen.',
    importance: 3,
    masteryPercentage: 55
  },
  {
    id: 5,
    title: 'What is cellular respiration?',
    status: 'Mastered',
    answer: 'Occurs in the mitochondria, breaking down glucose to produce ATP energy for the cell.',
    importance: 3,
    masteryPercentage: 100
  },
  {
    id: 6,
    title: 'Mitosis vs Meiosis - what is the difference?',
    status: 'Not started',
    answer: 'Mitosis produces two identical somatic cells, while meiosis produces four genetically distinct gametes.',
    importance: 2,
    masteryPercentage: 0
  },
  {
    id: 7,
    title: 'What are the stages of cell division?',
    status: 'Practicing',
    answer: 'The stages are prophase, metaphase, anaphase, and telophase, followed by cytokinesis.',
    importance: 2,
    masteryPercentage: 40
  },
];

export function CourseProgressDetailScreen({ onBack }: CourseProgressDetailScreenProps) {
  const { startPractice } = useApp();
  const [currentDay, setCurrentDay] = useState(3);
  const totalDays = 10;
  const [showEditPlan, setShowEditPlan] = useState(false);
  const [showMilestone, setShowMilestone] = useState<MilestoneType | null>(null);
  const [showDebugPanel, setShowDebugPanel] = useState(false);
  const [achievedMilestones, setAchievedMilestones] = useState<Set<MilestoneType>>(new Set());

  // Study plan settings
  const [studySettings, setStudySettings] = useState({
    targetScore: 85,
    dailyHours: 2,
    familiarity: 50
  });

  const handleSaveSettings = (newSettings: StudyPlanSettings) => {
    setStudySettings(newSettings);
    setShowEditPlan(false);
  };

  const completedPoints = knowledgePoints.filter(p => p.status === 'Mastered').length;
  const practicingPoints = knowledgePoints.filter(p => p.status === 'Practicing').length;
  const totalPoints = knowledgePoints.length;
  const overallPercentage = 86; // Fixed to match design

  // Check for milestones
  const checkMilestones = () => {
    const percentage = Math.floor((completedPoints / totalPoints) * 100);
    
    // First mastered point
    if (completedPoints === 1 && !achievedMilestones.has('first_mastered')) {
      setShowMilestone('first_mastered');
      setAchievedMilestones(prev => new Set(prev).add('first_mastered'));
      return;
    }
    
    // Progress milestones
    const milestoneChecks: { threshold: number; type: MilestoneType }[] = [
      { threshold: 20, type: 'progress_20' },
      { threshold: 40, type: 'progress_40' },
      { threshold: 60, type: 'progress_60' },
      { threshold: 80, type: 'progress_80' },
    ];
    
    for (const { threshold, type } of milestoneChecks) {
      if (percentage >= threshold && !achievedMilestones.has(type)) {
        setShowMilestone(type);
        setAchievedMilestones(prev => new Set(prev).add(type));
        return;
      }
    }
  };

  const handleMilestoneContinue = () => {
    setShowMilestone(null);
  };

  const debugTriggerMilestone = (type: MilestoneType) => {
    setShowMilestone(type);
  };

  // Get current date info to determine if today
  const isToday = true; // In real app, compare currentDay with today's date
  const pointsTitle = isToday ? "Today's Points" : `Day ${currentDay} Points`;

  // Sort knowledge points
  const sortedPoints = [...knowledgePoints].sort((a, b) => {
    // Status priority: Practicing > Not started > Mastered
    const statusPriority = {
      'Practicing': 0,
      'Not started': 1,
      'Mastered': 2
    };
    
    const statusDiff = statusPriority[a.status] - statusPriority[b.status];
    if (statusDiff !== 0) return statusDiff;
    
    // Within same status, sort by importance (3 > 2 > 1)
    return b.importance - a.importance;
  });

  const days = Array.from({ length: 9 }, (_, i) => {
    const dayNum = i + 1;
    return {
      day: dayNum,
      completed: dayNum < currentDay,
      isCurrent: dayNum === currentDay,
    };
  });

  return (
    <div className="bg-[#f8fafc] min-h-screen w-full flex flex-col">
      {/* Fixed Header */}
      <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-200 px-8 py-4 flex-shrink-0 sticky top-0 z-10">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <button
              onClick={onBack}
              className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors"
            >
              <ArrowLeft className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-600" />
            </button>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-900">AP Biology Plan</h1>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-0.5">Day {currentDay} of {totalDays}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button className="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 border border-gray-200">
              <span className="text-sm text-gray-600">Demo: In Progress</span>
              <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500" />
            </button>
            <button 
              onClick={() => setShowDebugPanel(!showDebugPanel)}
              className="p-2 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors"
              title="Debug Panel"
            >
              <Bug className={`w-5 h-5 ${showDebugPanel ? 'text-orange-500' : 'text-gray-400'}`} />
            </button>
            <button 
              onClick={() => setShowEditPlan(true)}
              className="px-4 py-2 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-2"
            >
              <Settings className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-600" />
              <span className="text-sm text-gray-600">Edit Plan</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Scrollable Content */}
      <div className="flex-1 px-8 pb-6">
        {/* Day Progress Timeline */}
        <div className="mt-8 mb-8">
          <div className="relative flex items-start justify-between w-full">
            {days.map((day, index) => (
              <React.Fragment key={day.day}>
                {/* Connector Line */}
                {index > 0 && (
                  <div
                    className={`absolute h-1 rounded-full ${
                      days[index - 1].completed && day.completed ? 'bg-emerald-500' : 
                      days[index - 1].completed && day.isCurrent ? 'bg-emerald-500' :
                      'bg-gray-200'
                    }`}
                    style={{
                      left: `calc(${((index - 1) / (days.length - 1)) * 100}% + 20px)`,
                      width: `calc(${100 / (days.length - 1)}% - 40px)`,
                      top: '20px',
                    }}
                  />
                )}
                {/* Day Node */}
                <div className="relative flex flex-col items-center z-10">
                  {/* Top indicator for current day */}
                  {day.isCurrent && (
                    <div className="w-12 h-1 bg-blue-500 rounded-full mb-3" />
                  )}
                  <div
                    className={`w-10 h-10 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm shadow-sm transition-all ${
                      day.completed
                        ? 'bg-emerald-500 text-white'
                        : day.isCurrent
                        ? 'bg-blue-500 text-white'
                        : 'bg-white text-gray-400 border-2 border-gray-200'
                    }`}
                  >
                    {day.completed ? (
                      <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 16 16" fill="none">
                        <path d="M13 4L6 11L3 8" stroke="white" strokeWidth="2" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round"/>
                      </svg>
                    ) : (
                      day.day
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <span
                    className={`mt-2 text-xs font-medium ${
                      day.isCurrent ? 'text-blue-600' : day.completed ? 'text-gray-600' : 'text-gray-400'
                    }`}
                  >
                    Day {day.day}
                  </span>
                </div>
              </React.Fragment>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Progress Card */}
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-sm border border-gray-100 p-8 mb-6">
          <div className="flex items-start gap-8">
            {/* Left: Progress Circle */}
            <div className="relative w-32 h-32 flex-shrink-0">
              <svg className="w-32 h-32 -rotate-90">
                <circle
                  cx="64"
                  cy="64"
                  r="56"
                  stroke="#e5e7eb"
                  strokeWidth="12"
                  fill="none"
                />
                <circle
                  cx="64"
                  cy="64"
                  r="56"
                  stroke="#2b7fff"
                  strokeWidth="12"
                  fill="none"
                  strokeDasharray={`${2 * Math.PI * 56}`}
                  strokeDashoffset={`${2 * Math.PI * 56 * (1 - overallPercentage / 100)}`}
                  strokeLinecap="round"
                />
              </svg>
              <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center">
                <span className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">{overallPercentage}%</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Center: Main Content */}
            <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col justify-between">
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">Keep Going!</h2>
                  <span className="px-3 py-1 bg-[#FDEA3B] text-gray-800 text-xs font-bold rounded-md">
                    Almost there!
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-4">
                  Day {currentDay} of {totalDays}  <span className="mx-1">·</span>  {completedPoints} of {totalPoints} points completed
                </p>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-gray-600">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Flame className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-500" />
                    <span className="font-medium">3-day streak</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Star className="w-4 h-4 text-yellow-500 fill-yellow-500" />
                    <span className="font-medium">{completedPoints} mastery</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-400" />
                    <span className="font-medium">2h 15m studied</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Right: CTA Section */}
            <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-3 flex-shrink-0">
              <p className="text-emerald-600 font-bold text-sm">Just a little more!</p>
              <button className="px-6 py-3 bg-[#2D8CFF] hover:bg-[#1e7ae8] text-white rounded-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 shadow-md transition-all">
                <Play className="w-4 h-4 fill-white" />
                Continue Day - 45m
              </button>
              <button className="px-4 py-2 bg-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-100 rounded-lg transition-colors flex items-center gap-2 border border-gray-200 text-sm text-gray-600">
                Practice mode: Multiple Choice
                <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4 text-gray-500" />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Today's Points Section */}
        <div className="mb-4">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 mb-1">{pointsTitle}</h3>
          <p className="text-sm text-gray-500">Tap to view answer</p>
        </div>

        {/* Knowledge Points List */}
        <div className="space-y-3 mb-8">
          {sortedPoints.map((point) => (
            <KnowledgePointRow
              key={point.id}
              title={point.title}
              status={point.status}
              answer={point.answer}
              importance={point.importance}
              masteryPercentage={point.masteryPercentage}
              onStartPractice={() => {
                // Navigate to practice mode with this knowledge point
                startPractice(String(point.id));
              }}
            />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
      
      {/* Edit Study Plan Popup */}
      {showEditPlan && (
        <EditStudyPlanPopup
          currentTargetScore={studySettings.targetScore}
          currentDailyHours={studySettings.dailyHours}
          currentFamiliarity={studySettings.familiarity}
          onConfirm={handleSaveSettings}
          onCancel={() => setShowEditPlan(false)}
        />
      )}

      {/* Milestone Modal */}
      {showMilestone && (
        <MilestoneModal
          type={showMilestone}
          onContinue={handleMilestoneContinue}
        />
      )}

      {/* Debug Panel */}
      {showDebugPanel && (
        <div className="fixed bottom-4 right-4 bg-gray-900 text-white rounded-2xl shadow-2xl p-6 max-w-sm z-50 border-2 border-orange-500">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Bug className="w-5 h-5 text-orange-500" />
              <h4 className="text-lg font-bold">Debug Panel</h4>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={() => setShowDebugPanel(false)}
              className="text-gray-400 hover:text-white transition-colors"
            >
              ✕
            </button>
          </div>
          
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 mb-3">Trigger milestone celebrations:</p>
            <button
              onClick={() => debugTriggerMilestone('first_mastered')}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-yellow-600 hover:bg-yellow-500 rounded-lg transition-colors text-sm font-medium text-left"
            >
              🎉 First Mastered
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => debugTriggerMilestone('progress_20')}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-orange-600 hover:bg-orange-500 rounded-lg transition-colors text-sm font-medium text-left"
            >
              🔥 20% Progress
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => debugTriggerMilestone('progress_40')}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-500 rounded-lg transition-colors text-sm font-medium text-left"
            >
              ⭐ 40% Progress
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => debugTriggerMilestone('progress_60')}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-purple-600 hover:bg-purple-500 rounded-lg transition-colors text-sm font-medium text-left"
            >
              🚀 60% Progress
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => debugTriggerMilestone('progress_80')}
              className="w-full px-3 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-500 rounded-lg transition-colors text-sm font-medium text-left"
            >
              🏆 80% Progress
            </button>
          </div>
          
          <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-gray-700">
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">
              Current: {completedPoints}/{totalPoints} points ({Math.floor((completedPoints / totalPoints) * 100)}%)
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default CourseProgressDetailScreen;
```

/* ===== FILE: src/app/screens/DashboardScreen.tsx ===== */
```tsx
import React, { useState } from 'react';
import { 
  Menu, Crown, ArrowRight, ChevronDown, 
  CheckCircle2, RefreshCw, Hourglass, LayoutDashboard, FileText, GraduationCap,
  Play, Star, TrendingUp, Clock, Zap, Trophy, Flame, Share2, Check, RotateCcw, ChevronLeft
} from 'lucide-react';

interface DashboardScreenProps {
  onStartPractice?: () => void;
  onViewAllKnowledgePoints?: () => void;
  onViewResources?: () => void;
  onStartMockExam?: () => void;
  onBackToSpaceSelector?: () => void;
  onViewCourseProgress?: () => void;
  onNavigateToAllNotes?: () => void;
  hasResourceUpdates?: boolean;
}

export function DashboardScreen({ 
  onStartPractice,
  onViewAllKnowledgePoints,
  onViewResources,
  onStartMockExam,
  onBackToSpaceSelector,
  onViewCourseProgress,
  onNavigateToAllNotes,
  hasResourceUpdates
}: DashboardScreenProps) {
  const [currentPage, setCurrentPage] = useState<'dashboard' | 'points-list'>('dashboard');
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(60); // 0 to 100
  const [demoStatus, setDemoStatus] = useState<'in-progress' | 'just-started' | 'day-completed' | 'course-completed'>('in-progress');

  const cycleProgress = () => {
    setProgress(p => {
      if (p === 0) return 60;
      if (p === 60) return 90;
      if (p === 90) return 100;
      return 0;
    });
  };

  const handleDemoChange = (status: 'in-progress' | 'just-started' | 'day-completed' | 'course-completed') => {
    setDemoStatus(status);
    if (status === 'just-started') {
      setProgress(0);
    } else if (status === 'day-completed' || status === 'course-completed') {
      setProgress(100);
    } else {
      setProgress(60);
    }
  };

  const getDashboardContent = () => {
    if (progress <= 20) {
      return {
        state: 'start',
        dayText: 'Day 1 of 10',
        subtitle: 'Let’s get started',
        details: '10 points to go',
        streak: 'Start your streak',
        mastery: '0%',
        ctaText: 'Start Learning',
        ctaTime: '',
        encouragement: '',
        badge: ''
      };
    } else if (progress < 80) {
      return {
        state: 'progress',
        dayText: 'Day 3 of 10',
        subtitle: '6 of 10 points completed',
        details: 'Only 4 left',
        streak: '3-day streak',
        mastery: '45%',
        ctaText: 'Continue Practice',
        ctaTime: '(11 min)',
        encouragement: '',
        badge: ''
      };
    } else if (progress < 100) {
      return {
        state: 'almost',
        dayText: 'Day 3 of 10',
        subtitle: '9 of 10 points completed',
        details: 'Only 1 left',
        streak: '3-day streak',
        mastery: '85%',
        ctaText: 'Finish Today',
        ctaTime: '',
        encouragement: '',
        badge: ''
      };
    } else {
      return {
        state: 'done',
        dayText: demoStatus === 'course-completed' ? 'Course Completed' : 'Day 3 of 10',
        subtitle: demoStatus === 'course-completed' ? 'All 10 days completed' : 'Day 3 Mastered!',
        details: '',
        streak: demoStatus === 'course-completed' ? '10-day streak' : '3-day streak',
        mastery: '100%',
        ctaText: demoStatus === 'course-completed' ? 'Review All Materials' : 'Preview Day 4',
        ctaTime: '',
        encouragement: '',
        badge: demoStatus === 'course-completed' ? 'Course Complete! 🎉' : ''
      };
    }
  };

  const content = getDashboardContent();

  const pointsData = {
    mastered: progress === 0 ? 0 : progress === 100 ? 10 : 2,
    practicing: progress === 0 ? 0 : progress === 100 ? 0 : 4,
    left: progress === 0 ? 10 : progress === 100 ? 0 : 4
  };
  const totalPoints = pointsData.mastered + pointsData.practicing + pointsData.left;

  if (currentPage === 'points-list') {
    return <PointsList onBack={() => setCurrentPage('dashboard')} onBackToSpaceSelector={onBackToSpaceSelector} totalPoints={totalPoints} onStartPractice={onStartPractice} />;
  }

  return (
    <div className="h-full bg-slate-50/50 pb-24 font-sans text-slate-900 overflow-y-auto">
      {/* Back to All Study Spaces - 如果需要的话 */}
      {onBackToSpaceSelector && (
        <div className="bg-slate-50/50 px-4 md:px-8 py-4 border-b border-slate-100">
          <button 
            onClick={onBackToSpaceSelector}
            className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 transition-colors group"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4 group-hover:-translate-x-0.5 transition-transform" />
            <span className="text-sm font-medium">Back to All Study Spaces</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      )}

      <main className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-8 py-6 md:py-8">
        {/* Unified Dashboard Card or Course Completed Card */}
        {demoStatus === 'course-completed' ? (
          <div className="bg-[#1a2838] rounded-3xl shadow-lg border border-slate-700 p-10 relative overflow-hidden flex flex-row gap-8 items-center">
            {/* Background decorations */}
            <div className="absolute top-0 right-0 -mr-20 -mt-20 w-72 h-72 bg-yellow-400/10 rounded-full blur-3xl"></div>
            <div className="absolute bottom-0 left-0 -ml-20 -mb-20 w-72 h-72 bg-blue-500/10 rounded-full blur-3xl"></div>

            {/* Left: Trophy Icon */}
            <div className="relative z-10 flex-shrink-0">
              <div className="w-32 h-32 bg-gradient-to-br from-yellow-500 to-amber-600 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center shadow-xl">
                <Trophy className="w-16 h-16 text-white" />
              </div>
            </div>
            
            {/* Center Content */}
            <div className="flex flex-col flex-1 relative z-10">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-2">
                <h2 className="text-3xl font-black text-white">Course Mastered!</h2>
                <span className="bg-yellow-500/20 text-yellow-400 text-xs font-bold px-3 py-1 rounded-md border border-yellow-500/30">
                  100% Complete
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-slate-300 text-sm font-medium mb-4">
                You've successfully completed all 10 days. Incredible dedication!
              </p>

              {/* Inline Status Row */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-5 text-sm text-slate-300">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Flame className="w-4 h-4 text-orange-400" />
                  <span className="font-semibold">10-day streak</span>

export default DashboardScreen;

function PointCard({ 
  title, 
  status,
  hint,
  explanation,
  importance,
  onStartPractice
}: { 
  title: string, 
  status: 'Mastered' | 'Practicing' | 'Not started',
  hint?: string,
  explanation?: string,
  importance?: number,
  onStartPractice?: () => void
}) {
  const [isFlipped, setIsFlipped] = useState(false);
  const isMastered = status === 'Mastered';
  const isPracticing = status === 'Practicing';
  
  return (
    <div 
      onClick={() => setIsFlipped(!isFlipped)}
      className="relative w-full h-48 cursor-pointer"
      style={{ perspective: '1000px' }}
    >
      <div 
        className={`relative w-full h-full transition-transform duration-500 ${isFlipped ? '[transform:rotateY(180deg)]' : ''}`}
        style={{ transformStyle: 'preserve-3d' }}
      >
        {/* Front of Card */}
        <div 
          className="absolute inset-0 bg-white rounded-2xl border-2 border-slate-200 shadow-sm p-6 flex flex-col justify-between"
          style={{ backfaceVisibility: 'hidden' }}
        >
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-3">
              <div className={`px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-bold tracking-wide ${
                isMastered ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700' : 
                isPracticing ? 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700' : 
                'bg-slate-100 text-slate-600'
              }`}>
                {status}
              </div>
            </div>
            <h4 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 leading-snug">{title}</h4>
          </div>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 italic">Tap to view hint</p>
        </div>

        {/* Back of Card */}
        <div 
          className="absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-br from-blue-50 to-purple-50 rounded-2xl border-2 border-blue-200 shadow-sm p-6 flex flex-col justify-between"
          style={{ backfaceVisibility: 'hidden', transform: 'rotateY(180deg)' }}
        >
          <div>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-600 mb-4 italic">{hint || 'No hint available'}</p>
            <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 italic">{explanation || 'No explanation available'}</p>
          </div>
          <button
            onClick={(e) => {
              e.stopPropagation();
              onStartPractice?.();
            }}
            className="w-full py-2.5 bg-blue-500 hover:bg-blue-600 text-white font-bold rounded-xl transition-colors"
          >
            Start Practice
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
      knowledgePointTitle: 'Linear Independence',
      text: 'A set containing the zero vector can never be linearly independent.',
      type: 'truefalse',
      correctAnswer: true,
      mastery: 88,
      dayId: 7,
      chapterId: 1,
    },
    {
      id: 17,
      knowledgePointId: 8,
      knowledgePointTitle: 'Determinant Properties',
      text: 'If two rows of a matrix are swapped, what happens to the determinant?',
      type: 'mcq',
      options: [
        'It stays the same',
        'It becomes zero',
        'Its sign changes',
        'It doubles'
      ],
      correctAnswer: 2,
      mastery: 78,
      dayId: 8,
      chapterId: 1,
    },
    {
      id: 18,
      knowledgePointId: 9,
      knowledgePointTitle: 'Rank-Nullity Theorem',
      text: 'Explain how the Rank-Nullity Theorem relates the dimension of domain, range, and null space. (100-150 words)',
      type: 'shortanswer',
      correctAnswer: '',
      mastery: 55,
      dayId: 9,
      chapterId: 4,
    },
    {
      id: 19,
      knowledgePointId: 1,
      knowledgePointTitle: 'Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors',
      text: 'The sum of eigenvalues of a matrix equals its trace.',
      type: 'truefalse',
      correctAnswer: true,
      mastery: 85,
      dayId: 1,
      chapterId: 2,
    },
    {
      id: 20,
      knowledgePointId: 2,
      knowledgePointTitle: 'Matrix Diagonalization',
      text: 'For a diagonalizable matrix A = PDP⁻¹, what does D represent?',
      type: 'mcq',
      options: [
        'The eigenvectors of A',
        'The transpose of A',
        'A diagonal matrix of eigenvalues',
        'The determinant of A'
      ],
      correctAnswer: 2,
      mastery: 72,
      dayId: 2,
      chapterId: 2,
    },
  ];

  // Filter questions based on config
  const examQuestions = useMemo(() => {
    if (!config) return allQuestions.slice(0, 20);

    let filtered = [...allQuestions];

    // Filter by scope
    if (config.scope.type === 'days' && config.scope.selectedDays && config.scope.selectedDays.length > 0) {
      filtered = filtered.filter(q => config.scope.selectedDays!.includes(q.dayId!));
    } else if (config.scope.type === 'chapters' && config.scope.selectedChapters && config.scope.selectedChapters.length > 0) {
      filtered = filtered.filter(q => config.scope.selectedChapters!.includes(q.chapterId!));
    } else if (config.scope.type === 'knowledgePoints' && config.scope.selectedKnowledgePoints && config.scope.selectedKnowledgePoints.length > 0) {
      filtered = filtered.filter(q => config.scope.selectedKnowledgePoints!.includes(q.knowledgePointId));
    }

    // Filter by mastery
    if (config.masteryFilter > 0) {
      filtered = filtered.filter(q => (q.mastery || 0) < config.masteryFilter);
    }

    // Shuffle and take the requested number
    const shuffled = filtered.sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
    return shuffled.slice(0, Math.min(config.numberOfQuestions, shuffled.length));
  }, [config]);

  // State
  const [currentQuestionIndex, setCurrentQuestionIndex] = useState(0);
  const [answers, setAnswers] = useState<Map<number, number | string>>(new Map());
  const [flagged, setFlagged] = useState<Set<number>>(new Set());
  const [timeRemaining, setTimeRemaining] = useState(() => {
    // Calculate initial time based on config
    const questionCount = config?.numberOfQuestions || 20;
    return questionCount * 75; // 1.25 minutes = 75 seconds per question
  });
  const [showSubmitConfirm, setShowSubmitConfirm] = useState(false);

  // Timer effect
  useEffect(() => {
    const timer = setInterval(() => {
      setTimeRemaining((prev) => {
        if (prev <= 0) {
          // Time's up - auto submit
          handleSubmit();
          return 0;
        }
        return prev - 1;
      });
    }, 1000);

    return () => clearInterval(timer);
  }, []);

  // Format time as HH:MM:SS
  const formatTime = (seconds: number) => {
    const h = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const m = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    const s = seconds % 60;
    return `${h}:${m.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${s.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  const currentQuestion = examQuestions[currentQuestionIndex];
  const totalQuestions = examQuestions.length;

  const handleAnswer = (answerValue: number | string) => {
    const newAnswers = new Map(answers);
    newAnswers.set(currentQuestion.id, answerValue);
    setAnswers(newAnswers);
  };

  const handleFlag = () => {
    const newFlagged = new Set(flagged);
    if (newFlagged.has(currentQuestion.id)) {
      newFlagged.delete(currentQuestion.id);
    } else {
      newFlagged.add(currentQuestion.id);
    }
    setFlagged(newFlagged);
  };

  const handleSubmit = () => {
    const totalTime = (config?.numberOfQuestions || 20) * 75;
    const results: ExamResults = {
      answers,
      flagged,
      timeSpent: totalTime - timeRemaining,
      totalTime,
    };
    onSubmit(results);
  };

  const goToQuestion = (index: number) => {
    setCurrentQuestionIndex(index);
  };

  const goToPrevious = () => {
    if (currentQuestionIndex > 0) {
      setCurrentQuestionIndex(currentQuestionIndex - 1);
    }
  };

  const goToNext = () => {
    if (currentQuestionIndex < totalQuestions - 1) {
      setCurrentQuestionIndex(currentQuestionIndex + 1);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-[#0b0e14] relative size-full">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="absolute bg-[#0b0e14] left-0 top-0 w-full border-b border-[#1e2939] px-8 pt-4 pb-[1px]">
        {/* Top row - Timer and Exit */}
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <div className="flex-1" />
          <div className="h-[42px]">
            <p className="font-['Inter'] font-bold text-[28px] text-white leading-[42px] tracking-[0.38px]">
              {formatTime(timeRemaining)}
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex-1 flex justify-end">
            <button
              onClick={onExit}
              className="h-[36px] px-4 rounded-[10px] border border-[#9f0712] bg-transparent"
            >
              <p className="font-['Inter'] font-medium text-[13px] text-[#ff6467] tracking-[-0.08px]">
                Exit Exam
              </p>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Question navigator */}
        <div className="flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-1">
          {examQuestions.map((q, index) => {
            const isAnswered = answers.has(q.id);
            const isCurrent = index === currentQuestionIndex;
            const isFlagged = flagged.has(q.id);

            return (
              <button
                key={q.id}
                onClick={() => goToQuestion(index)}
                className={`
                  w-[40px] h-[40px] rounded-[10px] flex items-center justify-center shrink-0
                  ${isCurrent ? 'bg-[#155dfc] shadow-[0px_0px_0px_2px_#51a2ff]' : 'bg-[#1e2939]'}
                  ${isFlagged ? 'ring-2 ring-[#FDEA3B]' : ''}
                `}
              >
                <p className={`font-['Inter'] font-bold text-[12px] ${isCurrent ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#99a1af]'}`}>
                  {index + 1}
                </p>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Content */}
      <div className="absolute left-0 top-[138px] w-full h-[calc(100%-138px)] overflow-clip">
        <div className="px-[112px] py-6 h-full flex flex-col">
          {/* Question */}
          <div className="mb-6">
            <div className="relative">
              <p className="font-['Inter'] font-bold text-[20px] text-white leading-[32.5px] tracking-[-0.45px] pr-12">
                {currentQuestion.text}
              </p>
              <button
                onClick={handleFlag}
                className="absolute right-0 top-0 w-[36px] h-[36px] rounded-[10px] flex items-center justify-center hover:bg-gray-800"
              >
                <Bookmark
                  className={`w-5 h-5 ${flagged.has(currentQuestion.id) ? 'fill-[#FDEA3B] text-[#FDEA3B]' : 'text-[#4A5565]'}`}
                />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Answer Options */}
          <div className="flex-1 flex flex-col gap-3 mb-6">
            {currentQuestion.type === 'mcq' && currentQuestion.options && (
              <>
                {currentQuestion.options.map((option, index) => {
                  const isSelected = answers.get(currentQuestion.id) === index;
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={index}
                      onClick={() => handleAnswer(index)}
                      className={`
                        relative w-full h-[58px] rounded-[14px] text-left
                        ${isSelected 
                          ? 'bg-[#155dfc] border-2 border-[#51a2ff]' 
                          : 'bg-[rgba(30,41,57,0.5)] border-[1.67px] border-[#364153]'
                        }
                      `}
                    >
                      <span className={`absolute left-[26px] top-[17px] font-['Inter'] font-semibold text-[15px] tracking-[-0.23px] ${isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#6a7282]'}`}>
                        {String.fromCharCode(65 + index)}.
                      </span>
                      <p className={`absolute left-[53px] top-[17px] font-['Inter'] font-medium text-[15px] tracking-[-0.23px] ${isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#d1d5dc]'}`}>
                        {option}
                      </p>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </>
            )}

            {currentQuestion.type === 'truefalse' && (
              <>
                {['True', 'False'].map((option, index) => {
                  const isSelected = answers.get(currentQuestion.id) === (index === 0);
                  return (
                    <button
                      key={index}
                      onClick={() => handleAnswer(index === 0)}
                      className={`
                        relative w-full h-[58px] rounded-[14px] text-left
                        ${isSelected 
                          ? 'bg-[#155dfc] border-2 border-[#51a2ff]' 
                          : 'bg-[rgba(30,41,57,0.5)] border-[1.67px] border-[#364153]'
                        }
                      `}
                    >
                      <span className={`absolute left-[26px] top-[17px] font-['Inter'] font-semibold text-[15px] tracking-[-0.23px] ${isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#6a7282]'}`}>
                        {String.fromCharCode(65 + index)}.
                      </span>
                      <p className={`absolute left-[53px] top-[17px] font-['Inter'] font-medium text-[15px] tracking-[-0.23px] ${isSelected ? 'text-white' : 'text-[#d1d5dc]'}`}>
                        {option}
                      </p>
                    </button>
                  );
                })}
              </>
            )}

            {currentQuestion.type === 'shortanswer' && (
              <textarea
                value={(answers.get(currentQuestion.id) as string) || ''}
                onChange={(e) => handleAnswer(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Type your answer here..."
                className="w-full h-[200px] p-4 rounded-[14px] bg-[rgba(30,41,57,0.5)] border-[1.67px] border-[#364153] text-[15px] text-[#d1d5dc] font-['Inter'] resize-none focus:outline-none focus:border-[#51a2ff]"
              />
            )}
          </div>

          {/* Navigation */}
          <div className="border-t border-[#1e2939] pt-4">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <button
                onClick={goToPrevious}
                disabled={currentQuestionIndex === 0}
                className="h-[45px] px-4 rounded-[10px] bg-[#1e2939] disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <p className="font-['Inter'] font-medium text-[14px] text-[#d1d5dc] tracking-[-0.15px]">
                  ← Previous
                </p>
              </button>
              
              {currentQuestionIndex === totalQuestions - 1 ? (
                <button
                  onClick={() => setShowSubmitConfirm(true)}
                  className="h-[45px] px-6 rounded-[10px] bg-[#FDEA3B] text-black font-['Inter'] font-bold text-[14px] hover:bg-[#fdf06d]"
                >
                  Submit Exam
                </button>
              ) : (
                <button
                  onClick={goToNext}
                  className="h-[45px] px-4 rounded-[10px] bg-[#1e2939]"
                >
                  <p className="font-['Inter'] font-medium text-[14px] text-[#d1d5dc] tracking-[-0.15px]">
                    Next →
                  </p>
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Submit Confirmation Modal */}
      {showSubmitConfirm && (
        <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center z-50">
          <div className="bg-[#1a1f2e] rounded-2xl p-8 max-w-[500px] w-full mx-4 border border-gray-700">
            <h3 className="text-[20px] font-bold text-white mb-3">Submit Exam?</h3>
            <p className="text-[14px] text-gray-400 mb-6">
              You have answered {answers.size} out of {totalQuestions} questions.
              {flagged.size > 0 && ` You have ${flagged.size} flagged question(s).`}
            </p>
            <div className="flex gap-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => setShowSubmitConfirm(false)}
                className="flex-1 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg bg-gray-800 text-white font-medium hover:bg-gray-700"
              >
                Review Answers
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={handleSubmit}
                className="flex-1 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg bg-[#FDEA3B] text-black font-bold hover:bg-[#fdf06d]"
              >
                Submit
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default MockExamScreen;
```

/* ===== FILE: src/app/screens/MockTestSetupScreen.tsx ===== */
```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ChevronDown, ChevronUp, Search, X } from 'lucide-react';

interface MockTestSetupScreenProps {
  onStartTest: (config: TestConfig) => void;
  onCancel?: () => void;
}

export interface TestConfig {
  scope: {
    type: 'all' | 'days' | 'chapters' | 'knowledgePoints';
    selectedDays?: number[];
    selectedChapters?: number[];
    selectedKnowledgePoints?: number[];
  };
  masteryFilter: number; // 0 = include all, 80 = exclude ≥80%
  questionComposition: 'balanced' | 'more-new' | 'more-tested';
  numberOfQuestions: number;
}

export function MockTestSetupScreen({ onStartTest, onCancel }: MockTestSetupScreenProps) {
  // Configuration state
  const [scopeType, setScopeType] = useState<'all' | 'days' | 'chapters' | 'knowledgePoints'>('all');
  const [selectedDays, setSelectedDays] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [selectedChapters, setSelectedChapters] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [selectedKnowledgePoints, setSelectedKnowledgePoints] = useState<number[]>([]);
  const [masteryFilterEnabled, setMasteryFilterEnabled] = useState(false);
  const [masteryFilterValue, setMasteryFilterValue] = useState<number>(80);
  const [questionComposition, setQuestionComposition] = useState<'balanced' | 'more-new' | 'more-tested'>('balanced');
  const [numberOfQuestions, setNumberOfQuestions] = useState<number>(20);
  const [customQuestionCount, setCustomQuestionCount] = useState<string>('');
  const [showAdvanced, setShowAdvanced] = useState(false);
  const [knowledgePointSearch, setKnowledgePointSearch] = useState('');

  // Mock data
  const days = Array.from({ length: 14 }, (_, i) => ({ id: i + 1, label: `Day ${i + 1}` }));
  const chapters = [
    { id: 1, label: 'Linear Algebra Foundations' },
    { id: 2, label: 'Eigenvalues & Eigenvectors' },
    { id: 3, label: 'Matrix Decomposition' },
    { id: 4, label: 'Vector Spaces' },
  ];
  const knowledgePoints = [
    { id: 1, label: 'Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors', mastery: 85 },
    { id: 2, label: 'Matrix Diagonalization', mastery: 72 },
    { id: 3, label: 'Spectral Theorem', mastery: 45 },
    { id: 4, label: 'Orthogonal Matrices', mastery: 90 },
    { id: 5, label: 'Singular Value Decomposition', mastery: 38 },
    { id: 6, label: 'Gram-Schmidt Process', mastery: 65 },
    { id: 7, label: 'Linear Independence', mastery: 88 },
    { id: 8, label: 'Determinant Properties', mastery: 78 },
    { id: 9, label: 'Rank-Nullity Theorem', mastery: 55 },
  ];

  const filteredKnowledgePoints = knowledgePoints.filter(kp =>
    kp.label.toLowerCase().includes(knowledgePointSearch.toLowerCase())
  );

  // Calculate estimated duration
  const estimatedDuration = Math.ceil((customQuestionCount ? parseInt(customQuestionCount) : numberOfQuestions) * 1.25);

  // Snap slider to meaningful values
  const snapSliderValue = (value: number) => {
    const snapPoints = [100, 90, 80, 60, 0];
    const closest = snapPoints.reduce((prev, curr) => 
      Math.abs(curr - value) < Math.abs(prev - value) ? curr : prev
    );
    return closest;
  };

  // Toggle selection helpers
  const toggleDay = (dayId: number) => {
    setSelectedDays(prev =>
      prev.includes(dayId) ? prev.filter(id => id !== dayId) : [...prev, dayId]
    );
  };

  const toggleChapter = (chapterId: number) => {
    setSelectedChapters(prev =>
      prev.includes(chapterId) ? prev.filter(id => id !== chapterId) : [...prev, chapterId]
    );
  };

  const toggleKnowledgePoint = (kpId: number) => {
    setSelectedKnowledgePoints(prev =>
      prev.includes(kpId) ? prev.filter(id => id !== kpId) : [...prev, kpId]
    );
  };

  // Get selected scope display text
  const getScopeDisplayText = () => {
    if (scopeType === 'all') return 'All content';
    if (scopeType === 'days' && selectedDays.length > 0) {
      const sortedDays = [...selectedDays].sort((a, b) => a - b);
      if (sortedDays.length <= 2) {
        return `Day ${sortedDays.join(', ')}`;
      }
      return `Days ${sortedDays[0]}–${sortedDays[sortedDays.length - 1]}`;
    }
    if (scopeType === 'chapters' && selectedChapters.length > 0) {
      return `${selectedChapters.length} chapter${selectedChapters.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
    }
    if (scopeType === 'knowledgePoints' && selectedKnowledgePoints.length > 0) {
      return `${selectedKnowledgePoints.length} knowledge point${selectedKnowledgePoints.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}`;
    }
    return 'No selection';
  };

  // Reset to defaults
  const handleReset = () => {
    setScopeType('all');
    setSelectedDays([]);
    setSelectedChapters([]);
    setSelectedKnowledgePoints([]);
    setMasteryFilterEnabled(false);
    setMasteryFilterValue(80);
    setQuestionComposition('balanced');
    setNumberOfQuestions(20);
    setCustomQuestionCount('');
    setShowAdvanced(false);
  };

  // Start test
  const handleStartTest = () => {
    const config: TestConfig = {
      scope: {
        type: scopeType,
        selectedDays: scopeType === 'days' ? selectedDays : undefined,
        selectedChapters: scopeType === 'chapters' ? selectedChapters : undefined,
        selectedKnowledgePoints: scopeType === 'knowledgePoints' ? selectedKnowledgePoints : undefined,
      },
      masteryFilter: masteryFilterEnabled ? masteryFilterValue : 0,
      questionComposition,
      numberOfQuestions: customQuestionCount ? parseInt(customQuestionCount) : numberOfQuestions,
    };
    onStartTest(config);
  };

  return (
    <div className="h-full flex flex-col bg-[#0B0E14] text-white">
      {/* Header - Center Aligned */}
      <div className="border-b border-gray-800 px-12 pt-6 pb-[6px] text-center">
        <h1 className="text-[24px] font-bold text-white mb-1">
          Set up your mock test
        </h1>
        <p className="text-[13px] text-gray-400">
          We'll generate a realistic exam based on your selection
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* Main Content - Single Column, Centered */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-y-auto">
        <div className="max-w-[600px] mx-auto px-12 pt-5 pb-8">
          
          {/* 1. Test Scope Selection */}
          <div className="mb-8">
            <h2 className="text-[15px] font-bold text-white mb-3">Test Scope</h2>
            
            {/* Scope Type Selector */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-4 gap-2 mb-4">
              <button
                onClick={() => setScopeType('all')}
                className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-[13px] font-medium transition-all ${
                  scopeType === 'all'
                    ? 'bg-[#FDEA3B] text-black'
                    : 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-700'
                }`}
              >
                All Content
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setScopeType('days')}
                className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-[13px] font-medium transition-all ${
                  scopeType === 'days'
                    ? 'bg-[#FDEA3B] text-black'
                    : 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-700'
                }`}
              >
                By Day
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setScopeType('chapters')}
                className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-[13px] font-medium transition-all ${
                  scopeType === 'chapters'
                    ? 'bg-[#FDEA3B] text-black'
                    : 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-700'
                }`}
              >
                By Chapter
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setScopeType('knowledgePoints')}
                className={`px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-[13px] font-medium transition-all ${
                  scopeType === 'knowledgePoints'
                    ? 'bg-[#FDEA3B] text-black'
                    : 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-700'
                }`}
              >
                By Points
              </button>
            </div>

            {/* Day Selection */}
            {scopeType === 'days' && (
              <div className="bg-gray-900/50 border border-gray-800 rounded-lg p-4 mb-3">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
                  {days.map(day => (
                    <button
                      key={day.id}
                      onClick={() => toggleDay(day.id)}
                      className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-[12px] font-medium transition-all ${
                        selectedDays.includes(day.id)
                          ? 'bg-[#FDEA3B] text-black'
                          : 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {day.label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Chapter Selection */}
            {scopeType === 'chapters' && (
              <div className="bg-gray-900/50 border border-gray-800 rounded-lg p-4 mb-3">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  {chapters.map(chapter => (
                    <button
                      key={chapter.id}
                      onClick={() => toggleChapter(chapter.id)}
                      className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-[13px] font-medium transition-all ${
                        selectedChapters.includes(chapter.id)
                          ? 'bg-[#FDEA3B] text-black'
                          : 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      {chapter.label}
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* Knowledge Points Selection */}
            {scopeType === 'knowledgePoints' && (
              <div className="bg-gray-900/50 border border-gray-800 rounded-lg p-4 mb-3">
                {/* Search */}
                <div className="relative mb-3">
                  <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 w-4 h-4 text-gray-500" />
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={knowledgePointSearch}
                    onChange={(e) => setKnowledgePointSearch(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="Search knowledge points..."
                    className="w-full pl-10 pr-3 py-2 bg-gray-800 border border-gray-700 rounded-lg text-[13px] text-white placeholder-gray-500 focus:outline-none focus:border-gray-600"
                  />
                  {knowledgePointSearch && (
                    <button
                      onClick={() => setKnowledgePointSearch('')}
                      className="absolute right-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-gray-500 hover:text-gray-400"
                    >
                      <X className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </button>
                  )}
                </div>
                {/* Points List */}
                <div className="space-y-2 max-h-[180px] overflow-y-auto">
                  {filteredKnowledgePoints.map(kp => (
                    <button
                      key={kp.id}
                      onClick={() => toggleKnowledgePoint(kp.id)}
                      className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-[12px] font-medium transition-all flex items-center justify-between ${
                        selectedKnowledgePoints.includes(kp.id)
                          ? 'bg-[#FDEA3B] text-black'
                          : 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span>{kp.label}</span>
                      <span className={`text-[11px] ${selectedKnowledgePoints.includes(kp.id) ? 'text-black/60' : 'text-gray-500'}`}>
                        {kp.mastery}%
                      </span>
                    </button>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
              Questions will be reused or generated as needed to match your scope
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* 2. Mastery Filter (Simplified) */}
          <div className="mb-8">
            <h2 className="text-[15px] font-bold text-white mb-3">Mastery Filter</h2>
            <div className="flex gap-2 mb-4">

                className={`flex-1 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-[13px] font-medium transition-all ${
                  !masteryFilterEnabled
                    ? 'bg-[#FDEA3B] text-black'
                    : 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-700'
                }`}
              >
                Include all
              </button>
              <button
                onClick={() => setMasteryFilterEnabled(true)}
                className={`flex-1 px-4 py-3 rounded-lg text-[13px] font-medium transition-all ${
                  masteryFilterEnabled
                    ? 'bg-[#FDEA3B] text-black'
                    : 'bg-gray-800 text-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-700'
                }`}
              >
                Exclude by mastery percentage
              </button>
            </div>

            {masteryFilterEnabled && (
              <div className="bg-gray-900/50 border border-gray-800 rounded-lg p-5">
                <div className="mb-3">
                  <label className="text-[13px] text-gray-300 font-medium">
                    Exclude questions with mastery ≥ {masteryFilterValue}%
                  </label>
                </div>
                <input
                  type="range"
                  min="0"
                  max="100"
                  value={masteryFilterValue}
                  onChange={(e) => setMasteryFilterValue(snapSliderValue(parseInt(e.target.value)))}
                  className="w-full h-2 bg-gray-700 rounded-lg appearance-none cursor-pointer accent-[#FDEA3B]"
                  style={{
                    background: `linear-gradient(to right, #FDEA3B 0%, #FDEA3B ${masteryFilterValue}%, #374151 ${masteryFilterValue}%, #374151 100%)`
                  }}
                />
                <div className="flex justify-between text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-2">
                  <span>0%</span>
                  <span>60%</span>
                  <span>80%</span>
                  <span>90%</span>
                  <span>100%</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* 3. Number of Questions */}
          <div className="mb-10">
            <h2 className="text-[15px] font-bold text-white mb-3">Number of Questions</h2>
            <div className="flex gap-2 mb-3">
              <button
                onClick={() => {
                  setNumberOfQuestions(10);

                }}

                  setNumberOfQuestions(30);

                }}

                  numberOfQuestions === 30 && !customQuestionCount

                }`}
              >

              />

            <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
              20 questions may cover 10–20 knowledge points
            </p>

          <div className="space-y-3">
            <button
              onClick={handleStartTest}
              className="w-full px-6 py-4 bg-[#FDEA3B] text-black rounded-lg text-[15px] font-bold hover:bg-[#fdf06d] transition-colors"

              >
                Cancel
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  { text: "Analyzing your notes…", duration: 1200 },
  { text: "Extracting key concepts", duration: 1200 },
  { text: "Organizing your study plan", duration: 1000 },
  { text: "Turning into practice cards", duration: 1000 },
  { text: "Almost ready…", duration: 600 }
];

export function PlanGenerationLoadingScreen({ onComplete }: PlanGenerationLoadingScreenProps) {
  const [currentStage, setCurrentStage] = useState(0);
  const [progress, setProgress] = useState(0);

  useEffect(() => {
    let accumulatedTime = 0;
    const timers: NodeJS.Timeout[] = [];
    
    // Stage transitions
    stages.forEach((stage, index) => {
      const timer = setTimeout(() => {
        setCurrentStage(index);
      }, accumulatedTime);
      timers.push(timer);
      accumulatedTime += stage.duration;
    });

    // Smooth progress animation
    const totalDuration = stages.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.duration, 0);
    const progressInterval = setInterval(() => {
      setProgress(prev => {
        const next = prev + (100 / totalDuration) * 50;
        return next >= 100 ? 100 : next;
      });
    }, 50);

    // Complete after all stages
    const completeTimer = setTimeout(() => {
      onComplete();
    }, totalDuration);
    timers.push(completeTimer);

    return () => {
      timers.forEach(clearTimeout);
      clearInterval(progressInterval);
    };
  }, [onComplete]);
```

```tsx
import {

import { useState } from "react";

interface KnowledgePointResult {
  id: number;
  title: string;
  examResult: "correct" | "incorrect" | "partial";
  practiceStatus: number; // mastery percentage
  questionsCorrect: number;
  questionsTotal: number;
}

interface PostExamReportScreenProps {
  score: number;
  totalQuestions: number;
  timeSpent: number;
  targetScore: number;
  onReviewTopic: (topicId: number) => void;
  onReturnToDashboard: () => void;
  onRetakeExam?: () => void;
}

export function PostExamReportScreen({
  score,
  totalQuestions,
  timeSpent,
  targetScore = 90,
  onReviewTopic,
  onReturnToDashboard,
  onRetakeExam,
}: PostExamReportScreenProps) {
  const [selectedFilter, setSelectedFilter] = useState<
    "all" | "conquered" | "needs-work"
  >("all");

  // Calculate percentage
  const percentage = Math.round((score / totalQuestions) * 100);

  // Mock knowledge point results
  const knowledgePointResults: KnowledgePointResult[] = [
    {
      id: 1,
      title: "Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors",
      examResult: "correct",
      practiceStatus: 95,
      questionsCorrect: 3,
      questionsTotal: 3,
    },

      id: 9,
      title: "Rank-Nullity Theorem",
      examResult: "partial",
      practiceStatus: 72,
      questionsCorrect: 1,
      questionsTotal: 2,
    },

  // Categorize results
  const conquered = knowledgePointResults.filter(
    (kp) => kp.examResult === "correct",
  );
  const needsReinforcement = knowledgePointResults.filter(
    (kp) =>
      kp.examResult === "incorrect" ||
      kp.examResult === "partial",
  );

  // Calculate predictions
  const currentPerformance = percentage;
  const gapToTarget = targetScore - currentPerformance;
  const hoursNeeded = Math.max(
    0,
    Math.round((gapToTarget / 10) * 1.5 * 10) / 10,
  ); // Rough estimate

  // Get grounded interpretation based on score
  const getInterpretation = () => {
    if (percentage < 60) {
      return "Baseline established";
    } else if (percentage < 80) {
      return "Clear starting point identified";
    } else {
      return "Strong foundation confirmed";
    }
  };

      ? knowledgePointResults
      : selectedFilter === "conquered"

        : needsReinforcement;

  const formatTime = (seconds: number) => {
    const hours = Math.floor(seconds / 3600);
    const minutes = Math.floor((seconds % 3600) / 60);
    return hours > 0 ? `${hours}h ${minutes}m` : `${minutes}m`;
  };

                    %

                </div>

                  {score} of {totalQuestions} correct
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* Interpretation */}
              <div className="flex-1 pt-4">
                <p className="text-[18px] font-semibold text-[#333] mb-3">
                  {getInterpretation()}
                </p>
                <p className="text-[14px] text-[#666] leading-relaxed">
                  {percentage < 60
                    ? `This exam identifies ${needsReinforcement.length} knowledge points requiring focused attention. The diagnostic data below shows exactly where to concentrate effort.`
                    : percentage < 80
                      ? `Performance indicates solid understanding with ${needsReinforcement.length} areas needing reinforcement. Review the breakdown below for targeted improvement.`
                      : `Results demonstrate strong command of core concepts. ${needsReinforcement.length} points identified for continued sharpening.`}
                </p>
                <div className="mt-4 pt-4 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center gap-4 text-[12px] text-[#999]">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />

                      Completed in {formatTime(timeSpent)}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <span>•</span>
                  <span>{totalQuestions} questions</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Primary KPI - Needs Work */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <div className="w-14 h-14 rounded-lg bg-amber-50 flex items-center justify-center flex-shrink-0">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-7 h-7 text-amber-600" />

                  Focus Areas Identified

                    {needsReinforcement.length}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[14px] text-[#666]">
                    knowledge points require attention
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Success Forecast - Lightweight */}
          {gapToTarget > 0 && (
            <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border border-gray-200 p-6">
              <p className="text-[11px] text-[#999] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">
                Estimated Path to {targetScore}%
              </p>
              <p className="text-[14px] text-[#333] leading-relaxed">
                At your current pace, reaching {targetScore}%
                may take approximately{" "}
                <strong>{hoursNeeded} hours</strong> of focused
                practice on the identified knowledge points.
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Knowledge Point Breakdown - Read-Only */}
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 p-6">
            <div className="mb-6">
              <h3 className="text-[16px] font-bold text-[#333] mb-2">
                Knowledge Point Breakdown
              </h3>
              <p className="text-[13px] text-[#666]">
                Diagnostic view of exam performance by topic
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Table */}
            <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-lg overflow-hidden">
              <table className="w-full">
                <thead className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-200">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="text-left px-6 py-3 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#666]">
                      Knowledge Point
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-center px-6 py-3 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#666]">
                      Exam Result
                    </th>
                    <th className="text-center px-6 py-3 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-[#666]">
                      Questions
                    </th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {knowledgePointResults.map((kp, index) => (
                    <tr
                      key={kp.id}
                      className={`border-b border-gray-100 ${
                        index ===
                        knowledgePointResults.length - 1
                          ? "border-b-0"
                          : ""
                      }`}
                    >
                      <td className="px-6 py-4">
                        <p className="text-[14px] text-[#333]">
                          {kp.title}
                        </p>
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 text-center">
                        {kp.examResult === "correct" ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-green-50 text-green-700 rounded text-[12px] font-medium">
                            <CheckCircle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            Correct
                          </span>
                        ) : kp.examResult === "incorrect" ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-red-50 text-red-700 rounded text-[12px] font-medium">
                            ✗ Missed
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 bg-amber-50 text-amber-700 rounded text-[12px] font-medium">
                            ~ Partial
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="px-6 py-4 text-center">
                        <span className="text-[13px] text-[#666]">
                          {kp.questionsCorrect} /{" "}
                          {kp.questionsTotal}
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Action Buttons - Bottom Only */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4 pt-4">
            {onRetakeExam && (
              <button
                onClick={onRetakeExam}
                className="flex-1 px-6 py-4 bg-[#FDEA3B] text-[#333] rounded-lg text-[15px] font-semibold hover:bg-[#FDD835] transition-all"
              >
                Retake Mock Exam
              </button>
            )}
            <button
              onClick={onReturnToDashboard}
              className="flex-1 px-6 py-4 bg-white border border-gray-300 text-[#333] rounded-lg text-[15px] font-semibold hover:border-gray-400 hover:bg-gray-50 transition-all"
            >
              Back to Dashboard
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

export default PostExamReportScreen;
```

```tsx
import { X, FileText, MessageSquare, BookOpen, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, GripVertical, Minimize2, Maximize2, Flag, Zap, WifiOff, RefreshCw, PanelRightOpen, PanelRightClose } from 'lucide-react';

        { id: 1, type: 'ppt', name: 'Linear Algebra Lecture 5.pptx', snippet: 'Eigenvalues of triangular matrices are found on the main diagonal...', page: 27 },

      id: 2,
      mode: 'truefalse',
      text: 'Every invertible matrix can be diagonalized.',
      correctAnswer: false,
      explanation: 'This is FALSE. While every invertible matrix has non-zero determinant, not all invertible matrices are diagonalizable. A matrix is diagonalizable if and only if it has enough linearly independent eigenvectors. Counter-example: a 2×2 shear matrix.',

        { id: 3, type: 'notes', name: 'Study Notes - Diagonalization', snippet: 'Important: Invertibility ≠ Diagonalizability. They are independent properties...' }

      id: 3,

      backText: 'The Spectral Theorem states that every symmetric real matrix is orthogonally diagonalizable. This means:\n\n• A = QΛQ^T where Q is orthogonal\n• All eigenvalues are real\n• Eigenvectors from different eigenspaces are orthogonal\n\nThis is fundamental for applications in quadratic forms, optimization, and principal component analysis.',
      text: 'What is the Spectral Theorem?',

      sources: [
        { id: 4, type: 'pdf', name: 'Advanced Linear Algebra.pdf', snippet: 'Spectral Theorem: Let A be a symmetric n×n real matrix...', page: 203 }

  // Handle retry/refresh
  const handleRetry = async () => {
    setIsRetrying(true);
    
    // Simulate network request
    setTimeout(() => {
      // In production, this would actually try to fetch new questions
      // For now, we'll just reset the error states
      setNetworkError(false);
      setCacheExhausted(false);
      setIsRetrying(false);
    }, 1500);

  const currentQuestion = questions[currentQuestionIndex];
  const totalQuestions = questions.length;

  // Handle answer selection
  const handleAnswerSelect = (answer: number | boolean) => {
    setSelectedAnswer(answer);
    setShowFeedback(true);
    
    // Calculate mastery change
    const correct = answer === currentQuestion.correctAnswer;
    const change = correct ? 3 : -3;
    setMasteryChange(change);
    setShowMasteryChange(true);
    
    // If correct answer, increment mastered points and check for milestones
    if (correct) {
      const newMasteredPoints = masteredPoints + 1;
      setMasteredPoints(newMasteredPoints);
      checkMilestones(newMasteredPoints);
    }
    
    // Hide the change indicator after 2 seconds
    setTimeout(() => {
      setShowMasteryChange(false);
    }, 2000);
  };

  // Check for milestones
  const checkMilestones = (currentMastered: number) => {
    const percentage = Math.floor((currentMastered / totalPoints) * 100);
    
    // First mastered point
    if (currentMastered === 1 && !achievedMilestones.has('first_mastered')) {
      setTimeout(() => {
        setShowMilestone('first_mastered');
        setAchievedMilestones(prev => new Set(prev).add('first_mastered'));
      }, 1500); // Delay to show feedback first
      return;
    }
    
    // Progress milestones
    const milestoneChecks: { threshold: number; type: MilestoneType }[] = [
      { threshold: 20, type: 'progress_20' },
      { threshold: 40, type: 'progress_40' },
      { threshold: 60, type: 'progress_60' },
      { threshold: 80, type: 'progress_80' }
    ];
    
    for (const { threshold, type } of milestoneChecks) {
      if (percentage >= threshold && !achievedMilestones.has(type)) {
        setTimeout(() => {
          setShowMilestone(type);
          setAchievedMilestones(prev => new Set(prev).add(type));
        }, 1500); // Delay to show feedback first
        return;
      }
    }
  };

  const handleMilestoneContinue = () => {
    setShowMilestone(null);
  };
  
  // Handle next question
  const handleNext = () => {
    if (currentQuestionIndex < totalQuestions - 1) {
      setCurrentQuestionIndex(currentQuestionIndex + 1);
      setSelectedAnswer(null);
      setShowFeedback(false);
      setActiveSource(null);
      setShowSourceList(false);
      setIsFlipped(false);
    }
  };

  // Handle flashcard flip
  const handleFlip = () => {
    setIsFlipped(!isFlipped);
    setShowFeedback(!isFlipped);
  };

  // Handle source traceback
  const handleTraceback = () => {
    if (currentQuestion.sources.length > 0) {
      setShowSourceList(true);
      setActiveSource(null); // Start with list view

  // Handle source selection from list
  const handleSourceSelect = (source: Source) => {

      setChatInput('');
    }
  };

  // Dragging logic
  const handleMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
    if (aiRef.current) {
      setIsDragging(true);
      const rect = aiRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
      setDragOffset({
        x: e.clientX - rect.left,
        y: e.clientY - rect.top
      });
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    const handleMouseMove = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (isDragging) {
        setAiPosition({
          x: e.clientX - dragOffset.x,
          y: e.clientY - dragOffset.y
        });
      }
    };

    const handleMouseUp = () => {
      setIsDragging(false);
    };

    if (isDragging) {
      document.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.addEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    }

    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
      document.removeEventListener('mouseup', handleMouseUp);
    };
  }, [isDragging, dragOffset]);

  }, [dailyGoalSeconds, showDailyGoalPopup]);

  // Cleanup focus timeout on unmount
  useEffect(() => {

  // Format time as MM:SS
  const formatTime = (seconds: number) => {

  const isCorrect = selectedAnswer === currentQuestion.correctAnswer;

  return (

                  >
```
